name: Leeching Tome raises Bloodbolt's leech and Rage cost (#3676)
contract: Leeching Tome 807489 is SpellFamilyName 26 with two effects over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 131072, 0), which is word 1 bit 17 - the eight Bloodbolt records (578304, 578305, 804685, 806928-806932) and no other family-26 row. Effect 0 is aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 27 (SPELLMOD_VALUE_MULTIPLIER) and BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50%; Bloodbolt 578304's effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_HEALTH_LEECH with EffectValueMultiplier 1.0, and SpellEffectInfo::CalcValueMultiplier applies SPELLMOD_VALUE_MULTIPLIER, so 1.0 becomes 1.5 = "leeches 50% more health". Effect 1 is aura 107 with MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) and +50 flat; Bloodbolt is PowerType 1 (Rage) with ManaCost 300, i.e. 30 Rage, so 300 -> 350 = "costs 5 additional Rage" ($/10;s2). Tooltip: "Your Bloodbolt now leeches $s1% more health, but it now costs $/10;s2 additional Rage." spell_modifier applies the player's live modifiers to a supplied base without a cast, so no rank has to be owned. This is a regression guard for behaviour that is already native; no fix accompanies it.

steps.label: No leech multiplier on Bloodbolt before the talent
Bloodbolt costs its authored 300 before the talent
Leeching Tome raises Bloodbolt's leech multiplier by 50%
Leeching Tome adds 50 (5 Rage) to Bloodbolt's cost
Leeching Tome does not touch Bloodmoon Blast
